## The Papers

You can find links to the class newspaper in the table below. To read articles from a specific news source, you can find links to their websites at the bottom of the page.

```{r}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

newspaper <- read_sheet_safe(NEWSPAPER_SHEET_URL)

if (nrow(newspaper) > 0 && "Link" %in% names(newspaper)) {
  newspaper <- newspaper |>
    filter(!is.na(Link) & Link != "") |>
    mutate(Link = sprintf("[%s](%s)", "Click here for link", Link))
}

if (nrow(newspaper) > 0 && "Link" %in% names(newspaper)) {
  newspaper |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = Link) |>
    cols_label(Edition = "Edition", Date = "Date", Link = "View") |>
    opt_interactive(use_sorting = TRUE, use_search = TRUE,
                    use_filters = FALSE, use_resizers = TRUE) |>
    opt_row_striping()
} else {
  cat("Class newspaper not available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# The outlet directory (local CSV; empty or missing is fine early on).
news <- tryCatch(read.csv(JOURNALIST_CSV), error = function(e) data.frame())

if (nrow(news) > 0) {
  news <- news |>
    mutate(Newspaper = ifelse(is.na(Link) | Link == "", Newspaper,
                              sprintf("[%s](%s)", Newspaper, Link))) |>
    select(-Link)

  news |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = Newspaper) |>
    cols_label(Newspaper = "Outlet") |>
    opt_interactive(use_sorting = TRUE, use_search = TRUE,
                    use_filters = FALSE, use_resizers = TRUE) |>
    opt_row_striping()
} else {
  cat("Newspaper list not available yet.\n")
}
```
